items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: That girl's name is Joyce Mayo there. The one that sang with you?

ctx.x: Cheerleaders picnic in 1950 at Audubon Park. For the handicapped. They could charge you in those days every once in a while. Goodwill had a party at Lyons Center. You know our time is running out. I've got a... That girl's name is Joyce Mayo there. The one that sang with you? Yeah, I don't know her name. Yeah, well you wouldn't remember her but I know her ex-husband.
That was a good band. Monk Hayes and Lou Cheek Morton two of my best men. I wish he could see them. I'd love to have that picture if it was complete.
